decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (1096.18.07-001, 1096.18.07-002, 1096.18.07-009, 1096.18.07-010, 1096.18.07-020, 1096.18.07-021, 1096.18.07-030, 1096.18.07-099, 1096.18.07-100, 1096.18.07-200, 1096.18.07-201, 1096.18.07-300. Received: 20/04/2018. 1096.18.05-109 Rev. C. Received: 27/06/2018) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The premises shall be used for a gym and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class D2 of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification).
description: Alterations to the building to provide a gym (D2) area in place of car parking
